title: NC-PL-6: PL-6: One-command install for a new organization
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** the backlog item PL-6 was parked needs-code by the in-tick doer
**Done check:** cmd:python3 scripts/needs_code_bridge.py --probe PL-6
**Status:** closed

PL-6: One-command install for a new organization

Backlog done check: see roadmap

Triage: An install command for new organizations requires creating code/scripts the in-Worker doer cannot write or edit. | first step: Draft a spec in the backlog detailing install steps (provision D1, repo setup, deploy) for a staff engineer to implement.

Bridged from the backlog by scripts/needs_code_bridge.py (NEEDS-CODE-BRIDGE-1). The change is code, data or a test that a loop consumes; a document alone does not close it.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 26.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
